2608.06351.title: Challenges in Evaluating Explanation Methods for Static and Evolving Data
2608.06351.paper_summary: This paper addresses the limitations of Explainable Artificial Intelligence (XAI) with respect to insufficient evaluation. They are illustrated through the DetoxAI image recognition system for bias detection and concept unlearning. Then, an example of a human-grounded evaluation of methods for explaining image classification is presented. The paper further explores methods for adapting explanations to evolving data streams with concept drift. Experiences with adapting counterfactuals for this problem are discussed. Finally it is related to the challenges of tracking the co-evolution of data, models, and explanations.\footnote{This paper has been accepted for a publication in J.Nalepa (ed) Explainable AI in Space. Proceedings of EASi 2026 Workshop at IJCAI-ECAI 2026 Bremen, Springer CCIS vol 3107 (2016).}
2608.06351.paper_summary_zh: 這篇論文探討了解釋性人工智慧（XAI）在評估不足方面的限制。<lb/>這些限制通過DetoxAI影像識別系統在偏見檢測和概念遺忘中的應用得以說明。<lb/>接著，提出了一個基於人類的影像分類解釋方法評估的例子。<lb/>論文進一步探討了如何將解釋適應於隨著概念漂移而演變的數據流的方法。<lb/>討論了在此問題上適應反事實的經驗。<lb/>最後，將其與追蹤數據、模型和解釋的共同演化挑戰相關聯。<lb/>\footnote{這篇論文已被接受於J.Nalepa（編輯）《太空中的可解釋AI》。2026年IJCAI-ECAI在不來梅舉行的EASi 2026研討會論文集，Springer CCIS第3107卷（2016年）。}
